question: to the Commission Siegbert Frank Droese (ESN) Subject:

A digital catch certificate system, known as CATCH, for all fishery products entering the EU came into force on 10 January 2026. The ambitious system replaced the previous paper-based process and is considered central to EU efforts to tackle illegal, unreported and unregulated fishing, help protect marine biodiversity and contribute to the EU’s broader efforts to simplify administrative procedures. 1.
How much did the CATCH system cost to develop?

What was this money spent on (e.g. consultation and planning, information infrastructure, programming or testing)? The Commission is asked to itemise the amounts over the entire period of development.
